筒.meaning: tube, pipe, cylinder — 封筒 (envelope), 水筒 (water bottle)
筒.label: noun

作.reading: サク, サ, つく(る)
作.meaning: make, create, produce — 作る (to make), 作品 (work/creation)
作.label: verb

荷.meaning: luggage, baggage, load — 荷物 (にもつ, luggage)
荷.label: noun

失.meaning: lose, miss, fail — 失礼 (rude/excuse me), 失う (to lose)
失.label: verb

礼.meaning: thanks, etiquette, bow, courtesy — 失礼, お礼 (thanks), 礼儀 (manners)
礼.label: noun

産.reading: サン, う(む), う(まれる)
産.meaning: give birth, produce, local product — お土産 (souvenir), 産業 (industry)
産.label: verb

旅.meaning: travel, trip, journey — 旅行 (りょこう, travel), 旅 (journey)
旅.label: noun

喜.meaning: rejoice, be glad, delight — 喜ぶ (to be happy), 喜び (joy)
喜.label: verb

葉.meaning: leaf, blade — 葉 (leaf), 言葉 (ことば, word/language), 紅葉 (autumn leaves)
葉.label: noun

所.reading: ショ, ジョ, ところ
所.meaning: place, location — 場所 (place), 住所 (address), 台所 (kitchen)
所.label: noun-suffix

使.meaning: use, employ, messenger — 使う (to use), 大使館 (embassy)
使.label: verb

両.meaning: both, two; counter for train cars — 両親 (parents), 両方 (both), 両手 (both hands)
両.label: prefix

冊.meaning: counter for books and bound volumes — sound changes: 一冊 いっさつ, 八冊 はっさつ, 十冊 じっさつ
冊.label: counter

文.reading: ブン, モン, ふみ
文.meaning: sentence, writing, literature — 文化 (culture), 文学 (literature), 作文 (composition)
文.label: noun

化.meaning: change, transform, -ization — 文化 (culture), 変化 (change), suffix like English '-ize/-tion'
化.label: noun-suffix

招.meaning: invite, beckon — 招待 (invitation), 招く (to invite/beckon)
招.label: verb

待.meaning: wait, await, expect — 待つ (to wait), 招待 (invitation), 期待 (expectation)
待.label: verb

絵.meaning: picture, drawing, painting — 絵 (え, picture), 絵本 (picture book)
絵.label: noun

指.meaning: finger, point, indicate — 指 (finger), 指輪 (ring), 指す (to point at)
指.label: noun

輪.meaning: ring, wheel, circle, loop — 指輪 (ring), 車輪 (wheel)
輪.label: noun

教えます.meaning: to teach, to tell, to inform (polite) — dictionary form: 教える. Pattern: 人に〜を教える (teach something to someone)
教えます.label: verb-ichidan

送ります.meaning: to send, to see (someone) off (polite) — dictionary form: 送る. Pattern: 人に〜を送る (send something to someone)
送ります.label: verb-godan

電話をかけます.meaning: to make a phone call (polite) — dictionary form: 電話をかける. Particle trap: ALWAYS を with かける, never に for the phone itself. To indicate who you're calling: 〜に電話をかける
電話をかけます.label: phrase-verb

まだ書きませんでした.reading: まだかきませんでした
まだ書きませんでした.meaning: still haven't written / didn't write yet — IMPORTANT trap: native Japanese prefers まだ書いていません (haven't written yet) using ていません form. まだ + past negative literally means 'still didn't' and sounds unnatural in most contexts. Lesson 7 introduces the contrast
まだ書きませんでした.label: phrase-verb

どうぞお上がりください.reading: どうぞおあがりください
どうぞお上がりください.meaning: Please come in (to a Japanese home) — literally 'please step up'; said because guests step UP from the genkan (entryway) onto the raised floor. Use this, NOT どうぞ入ってください, when welcoming someone into a home
どうぞお上がりください.label: set-phrase

失礼します.meaning: Excuse me / Pardon me / I'm leaving now — literally 'I commit a rudeness'. Used when: entering a room, leaving before others, interrupting, ending a phone call. Past form 失礼しました = 'sorry for the intrusion'
失礼します.label: set-phrase

お土産(おみやげ).meaning: souvenir, gift brought back from a trip — exception reading trap: 土産 is read みやげ (jukujikun, irregular). NOT どさん or つちうみ. Always with お prefix in polite use
お土産(おみやげ).label: noun
